card.name: Signs and criteria before symptom lists
card.fires_on: Words like "signs", "one", "more" and "include" that come right before a list of symptoms or clinical features, as in "Additional signs may include" or "changes in the signs and symptoms".

modes.label: Signs before symptoms
modes.description: The word "signs" after "Additional" or "changes in the", leading into a list of symptoms.
modes.example: monitor patients for changes in the<< signs>> and symptoms of asthma.

modes.label: One or more features
modes.description: "one" or "more" in the phrase "the presence of one or more" characteristics.
modes.example: Prescription should not depend solely on the presence of<< one>> or more of the behavioral characteristics.

modes.label: Criteria include
modes.description: The verb "include" after "Clinical criteria", leading into a list of findings.
modes.example: Clinical criteria<< include>> a symptomatic patient with pulmonary symptoms,
